title: Ningxin Su Invited as a Panelist at IEEE MASS 2026
titleZh: 苏宁新受邀担任 IEEE MASS 2026 专题讨论嘉宾
excerpt: Prof. Ningxin Su was invited as a panelist for “Agentic AI at the Wireless Edge” at IEEE MASS 2026, held at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University on October 22, 2026.
excerptZh: 苏宁新教授受邀担任 IEEE MASS 2026 专题讨论“Agentic AI at the Wireless Edge”的嘉宾。该讨论于 2026 年 10 月 22 日在香港理工大学举行。
